newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch announce new treasury certificate programme.
newsitem.headline: Dutch announce new treasury certificate programme.

text.p: The Dutch finance ministry said on Monday it was opening a new Dutch Treasury Certificate programme with a maximum issue amount of 7.5 billion guilders.
The programme, which matures on June 30 and is traded on a spot basis, is currently priced at 3.15 percent for settlement on April 9.
Including the new programme, the ministry now has four 7.5 billion guilder short-term borrowing programmes in issue, maturing on April 29, May 30, June 30 and December 31 respectively.
As of April 1 the ministry had received 7.475 billion under the April programme, 4.84 billion under the May programme and 3.63 billion under the December programme.
